clues: This city lies on the Aller River in Germany. It sits east of Hanover and far west of Berlin.
Rain is scarce here, more scarce than in most of Germany. Just a few weather posts in the land log less rain in a year.
This city was built in 1938 as a home for workers who made a famed car. It went by a long old name till 1945.
This city is the head home of Volkswagen, the car firm. Its car plant was the biggest in the world for years.
Next to the car plant stands the Autostadt. Guests there can see the full range of cars, from Audi and Bentley to Porsche.
